Modeling method: Students had to develop models to study the influence on mechanical properties and wear performance by different factors.
Measures: Measurement data of physical and mechanical exams were used to test model simulations.
Summary of research projects
The main research work of the students referred to the study of different materials and their role in the production of several components. In this part, two examples will be discussed in more detail.
Impact of microstructure and thermal treatment on the hardness of the impact on polyisotactic polypropylene (PISPP) and Poly (random-co-ethylene propylene) (RPP). F. Categlioglu and K. Živković
Analysis of mechanical and structural properties of the new generation ABS polymer that contains carbon and carbon fibers of Nano size.
Use surface coatings of polytherafluoroethylene and polyamide coatings. I. Fattouch and P.
